newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea kills 2 N.Koreans from submarine.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea kills 2 N.Koreans from submarine.

text.p: South Korean troops on Tuesday killed two North Korean agents who were among a group of 26 landed in the south in September from a submarine, a South Korean military spokesman said.
Only one of the 26 remains at large. Twenty-two of the 26 agents had been killed and one captured alive soon after the September 17 landing.
"So far 13 (North Koreans) have been shot dead and one captured. Eleven others killed themselves," spokesman Kang Joong-kwon said.
Kang did not say how the confirmation was made but one senior officer said Lee Kwang-soo, the captured North Korean, identified the killed agents.
The two men killed two South Korean officers and a soldier during fierce exchanges of fire on Tuesday before they were shot dead, he added.
